provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: The time-shift variable is named time_lag_case_A=23.34 (L8) although this directory is work_case_B -- whether 23.34 s is the correct lag for case B or a leftover from case A is not determinable from this file.
audit_member_text: The script is in work_case_B but names and applies `time_lag_case_A`. Whether 23.34 is deliberately shared with case A or copied from the wrong benchmark is not documented; a wrong lag shifts every modeled trace.

base_member_text: xlabel on the bottom panel reads 'x (m)' (L45) though the horizontal axis is time (t from B.txt column 1, shifted model time); likely a label error.
audit_member_text: The horizontal plot coordinate is `t`/`tmodel`, derived from column 1 and explicitly time-shifted, but the x-axis label is `x (m)` at L45. This is a direct units/semantics mismatch; it should identify time and its unit.

base_member_text: Station-to-gauge mapping (sta_0001->6, sta_0002->9, sta_0008->16, sta_0013->22, L3-6) depends on the gauge layout of the benchmark input not present in this file.
audit_member_text: Gauge-to-station mapping is encoded only in comments and assignments (6→0001, 9→0002, 16→0008, 22→0013). The mapping cannot be validated from this file and is vulnerable to dataset renumbering.
The fixed axis [25,41,-0.04,0.06] clips all panels identically without checking loaded ranges. Data outside the expected time/elevation window is silently hidden.

No shape checks precede indexing B.txt columns 1-5 or each station's columns 1-2, and no row alignment is needed because traces are plotted separately. Missing/short files fail at load/index time without a benchmark-specific diagnostic.
